label: class_g_06_home_01
text: Put away your phones. It is time to begin class.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_02
text: While you’re out performing fieldwork with one\nof your Pokémon walking alongside you...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_03
text: have you ever noticed changes in its coloration?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_04
text: Now I don’t mean that it suddenly becomes a\nShiny Pokémon or any nonsense like that.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_05
text: I am speaking of it becoming filthy![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_06
text: Pokémon battle! They get hurt by moves used\nagainst them![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_07
text: They get battered by wind and rain! They get\ncovered in sand and mud![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_08
text: They get, in a word, filthy![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_09
text: I have seen many a Trainer walking about with\ntheir adorable little Pokémon without addressing\r\nthis issue. It is deplorable.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_10
text: Let me ask this question of someone who I am\nsure would not tolerate such shameful conduct.\r\nAh yes, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_11
text: What should you do if your Pokémon is dirty?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_select_01
text: Clean it up

label: class_g_06_select_02
text: Pat it on the head

label: class_g_06_select_03
text: Nothing

label: class_g_06_home_answer_01
text: Perfectly correct! I knew I could count on you to\nprovide me with such an answer.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_answer_02
text:
While patting your Pokémon on the head to
express appreciation for its hard work would
make for an adorable moment, that would not
clean it of its filth![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_answer_03
text: I suppose, in time, filth accumulated from rain\nand mud may well fall of its own accord...but I\r\nnever expected such an answer from you.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_12
text: When your Pokémon are dirty, clean them!\nThis is, of course, simply common sense.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_13
text: While you are having a picnic, you can approach\nthe Pokémon on your team and perform a\r\nvariety of actions.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_14
text: One such action is putting them through what I\nlike to call the “Pokémon Wash”... In other words,\r\nyou are able to clean them up![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_15
text: You start by getting your sponge lathered up with\nsoapy bubbles as you gently and carefully scrub\r\nyour Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_16
text: Once your Pokémon is nice and covered in\nsoapy bubbles...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_17
text: the bubbles will encapsulate the filth, then you\nsimply wash it away with a spray of water![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_18
text: This will get your Pokémon clean and shining\nbright as a Tera Jewel![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_19
text: It is certainly quite a bit of work, but this will\nalso restore HP and cure status conditions.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_20
text:
However, some Pokémon may have parts of their
bodies that they don’t want scrubbed or that
they would rather not get wet.\c
Be sure to keep this in mind when cleaning your
Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_21
text: Now, the most important point that I must\nmention is that some Pokémon LIKE to be dirty.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_22
text: Though I will contradict myself by saying this,\nplease do remember that cleaning your Pokémon\r\nis not always the kind thing to do.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_06_home_23
text: Our time together has come to an end for today.\nI bid you all farewell.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
